10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:317fc4a2-d3e2-45.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Pricing Manager – AI Trainer (Freelance, 8–20 hrs/week, Remote EU/UK) Are you a seasoned professional in pricing strategy, quantitative analysis, or financial modeling? Are you interested in helping shape the future of artificial intelligence by teaching AI to reason about real-world pricing methodologies? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Pricing Manager AI Trainer and contribute your expertise to advanced AI education—flexibly, remotely, and on your schedule. About Us 10x Team connects freelance professionals with leading AI labs to develop next-generation AI models. We are seeking Pricing Managers based in the EU or UK to ensure AI-generated outputs meet the practical standards and nuanced decision-making expected in industry. Key Responsibilities: - Review and enhance AI-generated content related to pricing strategy, margin analysis, and competitive positioning - Evaluate the realism, relevance, and analytical rigor of pricing methodologies proposed by AI - Draft example scenarios, case studies, and calculations using your pricing expertise - Create scenario variations reflecting viewpoints such as pricing analysts, business managers, and clients - Identify flawed assumptions, unrealistic pricing models, or compliance gaps and provide clear, actionable feedback In essence: You will use your pricing experience to help AI better understand and reason about effective, robust pricing strategies and frameworks. About You: - Senior Pricing Manager or similar, with hands-on experience in pricing, financial modeling, or analytics - Based in the EU or UK - Demonstrated expertise in reviewing pricing strategies, conducting margin analysis, and implementing pricing controls - Highly organized and able to communicate direct, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week with reliable, timely responses Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance work—100% remote - Use your industry expertise to build smarter AI systems - Direct impact: teach AI about complex pricing challenges and approaches - Free access to our AI Academy for upskilling - Structured onboarding, clear briefs, ongoing collaborative projects How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the future of AI-driven pricing analysis—apply today! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power and control systems. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. jobgether-jobgether:lever:2702ef89-d7f2-.title: z/OS Network Systems Administrator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2702ef89-d7f2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a z/OS Network Systems Administrator based in India. This is a fully remote opportunity supporting critical enterprise mainframe and network environments. You will take ownership of IBM z/OS networking, connectivity, messaging, and operational support. The role combines hands-on administration with complex troubleshooting across core mainframe technologies. You will help maintain reliable connections between z/OS and systems such as MQ, DB2, CICS, and middleware. Automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational improvements will be important parts of your work. You will collaborate closely with enterprise network and security teams on infrastructure initiatives and modernization. This role is well suited to an experienced mainframe networking professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. Provide hands-on administration, troubleshooting, and operational support for IBM z/OS Communication Server, including VTAM, TCP/IP, TN3270, FTP, Policy Agent, and SMTP. Manage day-to-day activities within the z/OS mainframe environment using TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, and catalog management. Execute and interpret z/OS and JES2 operator commands to support network and system operations. Develop and maintain automation and operational tools using TSO/REXX, TSO/CLIST, or SAS. Configure and troubleshoot mainframe connectivity for MQ, DB2, CICS, and related middleware platforms. Support end-to-end file transfer, printing, email, and messaging infrastructure. Build and maintain monitoring, reporting, troubleshooting, and auditing tools for network operations. Partner with enterprise network services and security teams on network design, upgrades, implementations, testing, and verification. Investigate complex infrastructure and connectivity issues and contribute to operational improvements and modernization initiatives. Support reliable production operations and collaborate with application teams on connectivity requirements and network-related issues when needed. Requirements Hands-on experience administering and supporting IBM z/OS Communication Server in an enterprise environment. Strong knowledge of VTAM, TCP/IP, TN3270, FTP, Policy Agent, and SMTP. Solid practical experience working with z/OS mainframe systems and related operational processes. Proficiency with TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, and z/OS catalog management. Experience using z/OS and JES2 operator commands for system and network operations. Programming or scripting experience with REXX, CLIST, or SAS, with an ability to automate operational tasks. Experience configuring and troubleshooting connectivity involving MQ, DB2, CICS, and other middleware technologies. Experience supporting file transmission, printing, email, and messaging environments. Ability to develop or maintain network monitoring, reporting, troubleshooting, and operational tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, particularly when diagnosing complex mainframe connectivity issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with network, security, infrastructure, and application teams. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred but equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Experience with Broadcom/CA NetMaster and NCL programming, PKWARE PKZip, IBM Sterling Connect:Direct, Secure Proxy technologies, or disaster recovery testing is an advantage. Knowledge of AI concepts, methodologies, and tools relevant to mainframe or network operations is a plus. Benefits Fully remote position for candidates based in India. Full-time employment opportunity supporting a large-scale enterprise technology environment. Opportunity to work with complex IBM z/OS networking and mainframe infrastructure. Exposure to enterprise network, security, middleware, and modernization initiative

jobgether-jobgether:lever:461da56f-1dd9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst, Credit Risk – Analyste en assurance qualité, risque de crédit based in Canada. This role sits at the intersection of mortgage underwriting, quality assurance, fraud prevention, and credit risk management. You will review mortgage applications before and after funding to ensure compliance with underwriting standards, internal policies, insurer guidelines, and regulatory requirements. The position plays an important role in identifying anomalies, suspicious activity, documentation concerns, and potential sources of financial loss. You will conduct investigations, prepare detailed QA reports, and provide recommendations to underwriting and risk stakeholders. Working in a technology-enabled mortgage environment, you will collaborate with internal teams, insurers, investors, and external partners. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on credit quality, risk mitigation, and the integrity of mortgage operations. Review a daily sample of mortgage applications before and after funding to verify compliance with underwriting standards, internal policies, insurer requirements, and applicable regulations. Assess application data, financial documentation, client information, broker and insurer submissions, and legal documentation to identify discrepancies or policy deviations. Identify unusual behavioural patterns, suspicious transactions, potential misrepresentation, and document validity concerns using internal referrals and external insurer alerts. Conduct preliminary investigations into suspicious files and take appropriate action to reduce fraud exposure, credit losses, and other financial risks. Prepare comprehensive quality assurance reports documenting findings, irregularities, risk observations, and recommendations. Perform additional analysis and investigations as requested by Risk or Quality Assurance leadership. Support audits conducted with partners, investors, and insurers, from preparation through to the resolution of findings. Assist with the management, periodic review, and quality control of approved lists covering appraisers, solicitors, brokers, vendors, and anti-money-laundering (AML) resources. Execute quality assurance and quality control reviews consistently, objectively, efficiently, and within required timelines. Provide guidance, opinions, and recommendations to underwriting teams and stakeholders regarding credit risks, loss mitigation, flood and property risks, and potential training opportunities. Identify trends and recurring issues within underwriting practices and contribute insights that can strengthen controls, processes, and risk management. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in mortgage or lending adjudication, underwriting, or a closely related credit function. Experience working within the mortgage broker channel is preferred. Strong knowledge of mortgage insurer requirements, internal and external underwriting guidelines, fraud indicators, detection methodologies, and risk mitigation practices. Strong analytical, investigative, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to recognize trends, patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies in mortgage files. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, exercise sound judgment, prioritize urgent matters, and make difficult or unpopular recommendations when necessary. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, and SharePoint, as well as Google Workspace applications such as Drive, Sheets, and Docs. Experience working with CRM and workflow platforms such as Salesforce. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and risk concerns to management and underwriting teams. Fluency in both English and French is preferred to support stakeholders and clients across Canad

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8ff2a255-935c-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8ff2a255-935c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Sweden. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ee53c2ed-7659-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in Netherlands. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. wattpad-wattpad:lever:c264ebd5-1d05-456c.description: WEBTOON Entertainment is a leading global entertainment company and home to some of the world's largest storytelling platforms. As the global leader and pioneer of the mobile webcomic format, WEBTOON Entertainment has transformed comics and visual storytelling for fans and creators. With its CANVAS UGC platform empowering anyone to become a creator, and a growing roster of superstar WEBTOON Originals creators and series, WEBTOON Entertainment’s passionate fandoms are the new face of pop culture. WEBTOON Entertainment adaptations are available on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Crunchyroll, and other screens around the world, and the company’s content partners include The Walt Disney Company, HYBE, and DC Comics, among many others. The Global Corporate Development team works directly with WEBTOON management to identify, evaluate, and execute inorganic growth opportunities through acquisitions, investments, or strategic partnerships. This position plays a critical role in accelerating WEBTOON’s global expansion by collaborating with key stakeholders to ensure internal alignment with the company’s strategic priorities. This is an exciting and challenging role in a fast-moving industry. The ideal candidate is expected to bring financial analysis and deal experience, as well as strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication is also a must, for engaging both internal and external stakeholders.
